user_stories.title: US-01: Load configuration from .env and the environment
user_stories.description: As a developer, I want the tool to read its settings from a .env file and the environment so that credentials and targets stay out of the code.
acceptance_criteria: Read GITLAB_URL, GITLAB_TOKEN and GITLAB_PROJECTS from the environment.
Load .env without overriding variables that are already present.
Fail with a message that names the missing variable before any API call.
definition_of_done: Configuration loads from a fresh checkout with only a .env present.
A missing token is reported before the first request.
The precedence between environment and .env is documented.

user_stories.title: US-02: Validate a document offline
user_stories.description: As a developer, I want to validate a JSON document without contacting GitLab so that I can catch mistakes before anything is written.
acceptance_criteria: Perform no network request while validating.
Point every error at the file and the field.
Exit with a non-zero code when at least one error is found.
definition_of_done: Validation runs without a token in the environment.
A malformed document reports at least one error.

user_stories.title: US-03: Preview every write with dry run
user_stories.description: As a developer, I want a dry run mode that reports every action and writes nothing so that I can review a change before applying it.
acceptance_criteria: Send no POST, PUT or DELETE request while dry run is on.
Use the past conditional in the final summary.
Keep every item title scoped so a real run can skip it later.
definition_of_done: A dry run against a real group changes nothing.
The summary reports what would be created.

user_stories.title: US-04: Degrade gracefully on groups without epics
user_stories.description: As a developer, I want the item commands to keep working on a Free group so that a missing licence does not block the backlog.
acceptance_criteria: Explain a 403 from the epics API as a licence limit.
Still create the stories and issues, without their epic.
Offer a flag to skip the epic lookup entirely.
definition_of_done: stories create succeeds on a group without epics.
The behaviour is covered by a test.
